verses.1: Hear, children, what your father has said; and listen carefully to gain understanding.
verses.2: For I have given you My Torah as good. Do not take away it from you.
verses.3: For I was the only son of my father, and I was his sole child before my mother.
verses.4: And he questioned me, saying to me, “O my son, hear my words. Obey my commands and live.”
verses.5: Buy wisdom; buy understanding. Do not forget it, and do not lose the words that come from your mouth.
verses.6: Do not leave her; keep her in your love and care.
verses.7: At the beginning, wisdom was given to him; and in all that he acquired, he also received wisdom.
verses.8: Salsela and Trommekha will delight you, for they are our beloved ones.
verses.9: Give your head the grace of beauty and adornment.
verses.10: Listen, my son, and take my words to heart. May they bring you many years of life.
verses.11: In wisdom, you have guided me along the paths of righteousness.
verses.12: When you go, your steps will not be hindered; and if you run, you will not stumble.
verses.13: The strength in the process of creation is not to be destroyed, for it is eternal.
verses.14: Do not enter the house of the wicked, and do not walk in their paths.
verses.15: May not there be any dirt or filth on it.
verses.16: For they will not be able to change their ways unless they repent. Their years will be wasted if they do not change their behavior.
verses.17: For evil bread and bad wine will cause people to become drunk.
verses.18: And the light of the righteous will shine like the light of a lamp that continues to burn until the end of the day.
verses.19: The path of the wicked is like darkness; they will never know what awaits them.
verses.20: Son, listen to my words. Pay attention to what I say.
verses.21: Do not let them be hidden from your eyes; they are kept within your heart.
verses.22: For they are alive, and their words bring healing to all who hear them.
verses.23: From every corner of the world, let your heart be filled with hope, for from there will come life.
verses.24: May the stubbornness of your heart be removed from you, and may your words be kept away from you.
verses.25: Your eyes shall watch over us, and your eyelids shall be turned away from you.
verses.26: May your feet be bound, and all your paths be blocked.
verses.27: Do not let Al-Tet-Yamim and Shemoel take your feet away from evil.
